name: ticket-api

dependencies.name: triage-agent
dependencies.description: Classifies a newly submitted ticket's urgency and drafts a reply.

dependencies.name: email-service
dependencies.description: Sends the approved reply to the customer by email.

description: Owns tickets and their drafted/approved replies. Accepts public ticket submissions, calls triage-agent to classify urgency and draft a reply, serves the signed-in support agent's queue and detail views, and on approval sends the reply via email-service. Holds no UI and does not itself classify or draft text.
